subject: reasoning
question:
H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only I sits between V and H. H sits third to the left of K. W sits to the immediate left of K. J is not an immediate neighbour of H.

Who sits fourth to the left of U?
solution:
H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only I sits between V and H.
 
• H sits third to the left of K.
 
• W sits to the immediate left of K.
 
• J is not an immediate neighbour of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eabd4fc1b39d7c1589181d2f5e968c08c44c402e427f0cb13896a32cedc5486e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
